_comment: Sandbox cell OpenCode config (see specs/04-worker-cell.md). Delivered via OPENCODE_CONFIG env. Inference goes through the cell L7 proxy: baseURL is a placeholder the proxy rewrites while injecting the real token. EXPERIMENT PENDING: confirm which provider block the proxy serves, lock it, delete the other.

_alternative_openai_compatible.comment: If the proxy serves OpenAI-compatible routes instead, replace the provider block above with a custom provider of package @opencode-ai/ai/providers/openai-compatible pointed at the placeholder URL, e.g. baseURL https://inference.local/v1 with the target model IDs. Confirm via experiment first.
